# Create Service Blueprint

## Instructions

Use this skill when mapping a user journey or service flow for Mulo. Read `.cursor/rules/create-service-blueprint.mdc` for the canonical Cursor rule this skill mirrors.

## Steps

1. Read and use `templates/template-service-blueprint.md` as the document skeleton. Fill in every bracketed placeholder.
2. Read `docs/vision-and-product.md` for the three-layer product model (See / Learn / Act) to ground the journey context.
3. Read `knowledge/personas.md` to ensure the User Actions column reflects real persona behaviours and motivations.

## Quality Checklist

- Every phase row must have all five columns completed (Phase, User Actions, Front-stage Interactions, Back-stage Processes, Support Processes).
- The Line of Visibility section must clearly separate what the user sees from what runs behind the scenes.
- Pain Points must be actionable, not vague.
